egltest.caveat: host-throughput smoke evidence, not a benchmark (tiny surfaces; run-to-run variance large); device re-run will re-freeze these numbers
egltest.exit_contract: 0 = all executed checks passed (onscreen skipped with note when no DISPLAY); 1 = EGL/GL setup or API error; 2 = usage error; 3 = pixel self-check MISMATCH
egltest.llvmpipe_env: bench host, GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1, renderer 'llvmpipe (LLVM 23.1.4, 256 bits)', Mesa 26.2.6-arch1.1 (device LLVM/Mesa rev will differ: LLVM 23.1.5, 128 bits, Mesa 26.3.0)
egltest.llvmpipe_offscreen: 60 draws in 0.008 s = 7972.4 FPS (256x256); second run 60 draws in 0.009 s = 7022.9 FPS

env.xorg: fbdev 720x1280, DRISWRAST (AIGLX: Screen 0 is not DRI2 capable)

glmark2_es2.prior_run_note: The earlier gpu-verify run was timeout-cut (29 of 30 scenes reported, no Score line); its per-scene values are verbatim in gpu-verify.md section 3.3 and canonicalised in code/gpu31/tests/scenes.tbl (31 rows).
glmark2_es2.provenance: G31_MesaTests3 fresh full sweep 2026-11-19 (llvmpipe, 320x240, -b :duration=2.0); full per-scene table lives in the gpu31-mesatests report.
glmark2_es2.scene_table: code/gpu31/tests/scenes.tbl (per-scene floors stay canonical there until a deliberate re-baseline)

glxgears.note: X11/GLX reference only. This is NOT the egltest fps: egltest is a separate EGL+GLES2 binary owned by G31_EglTest.

gpu_idle_signature.meaning: Software render leaves the kbase GPU idle; hardware render must move at least one of utilization / tis_total.

H1_renderer.command: run-harness.sh --expect hardware (G1: first renderer-string hit across glxinfo-B.log, es2_info.log, eglinfo-B.log)
H1_renderer.warn: class hardware-unknown (non-software, unrecognised id): PASS but record the id in the verdict notes

H2_score.command: glmark2-es2 -s 320x240 -b :duration=2.0 --results fps; parse the 'glmark2 Score: N' line
H2_score.fail: N < 52 (below 50% of the llvmpipe baseline: the driver path is broken, e.g. sync stalls or readbacks)
H2_score.warn: 52 <= N < 103: run carries a written explanation

H3_scenes.command: tools/check-floors.sh scenes.tbl glmark2-es2.log (floor = max(baseline x 0.5, 5 FPS))
H3_scenes.fail: Broken capture only (<5 FPS lines: re-run, never a score FAIL)
H3_scenes.pass: Every non-heavy scene at/above floor; every heavy scene above its must-exceed value
H3_scenes.warn: Below-floor scene, or heavy scene stuck at ideas<=1 / jellyfish<=1 / terrain<=2 / refract<=4: run carries a written explanation

H4_surface_2d.fail: Unparseable dump, geometry mismatch, or distinct < 100 (blank/degenerate capture)
H4_surface_2d.pass: Parseable dump, geometry 720x1280, distinct >= 100 (llvmpipe proof had 2065)

H5_gpu_activity.command: tools/get-gpu-state.sh before vs after the GL load (G4)
H5_gpu_activity.fail: Sysfs present but unreadable (tooling fault, not a value fault)
H5_gpu_activity.pass: utilization > 0 or tis_total growth across the load
H5_gpu_activity.warn: Flat-0 (utilization=0, tis unchanged) under a hardware renderer: run carries a written explanation

H6_egltest.command: egltest binary default run (offscreen 256x256 + onscreen when DISPLAY set); canonical line is the [offscreen] 60-draws FPS line
H6_egltest.fail: Nonzero exit (exit 1 self-check failure; exit 3 usage/setup): correctness gate from day one
H6_egltest.severity: correctness FAIL gate; fps gate deferred
H6_egltest.warn: provisional (bench-host, not device): record both offscreen and onscreen fps lines; gate on correctness (exit 0) and pixel readbacks; fps comparison activates at device re-freeze

hw_acceptance.overall: HW PASS requires H1 + H4 PASS, H2 not-FAIL, H6 exit 0, and every H2/H3/H5 WARN paired with a written explanation in the verdict notes.
